content:
The Kills, "Hook And Line"
(Midnight Boom, 2008)

NOTE: I did this in D Tuning (i.e. Standard but with every string 1 step down) 
because it was easier to play - you can use power chords and just slide up and down 
the fret board. Remember that each power chord will be 2 frets higher up on the fret board now, 
e.g. a G will start on 5th fret, not 3rd.
